title: Verify: Remount restores saved state unit tests
summary: Unit tests for remount restore using mocked storage
description: Add tests asserting that state written to the mocked storage is restored on remount and that null saved state starts fresh.
acceptance_criteria: Given Search performed, when App unmounted, remounted and Begin clicked, then history has the hidden door text and Bookshelf data-open is true
Given readSaved returns null, when App begins, then the Dialogue region shows the opening text
technical_constraints: Intro gate resets on remount, so Begin must be clicked again

steps.action: Render <App/>, click Begin, Bookshelf, Search; call unmount() from the render result; render <App/> again and click Begin; assert history toHaveTextContent('A hidden door swings open behind the books.'), button 'Bookshelf' toHaveAttribute('data-open','true'), and region 'Inventory' is in the document.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/appFlow.test.tsx -t 'remount'

steps.symbol: it('starts fresh when nothing is saved')
steps.action: With saved = null, call begin(); assert region 'Dialogue' toHaveTextContent("I don't know what to do next. What should we do?") and Bookshelf data-open is 'false'.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/appFlow.test.tsx -t 'remount|fresh'
